sys_email_template.name: auth.password_reset
sys_email_template.label: Password Reset
sys_email_template.subject: Reset your {{appName}} password
sys_email_template.body_html:
Reset your password

Hi {{user.name}},

We received a request to reset the password for the account associated with {{user.email}}.

Click the button below to choose a new password. This link expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes.

Reset password

Or copy and paste this URL into your browser:
{{resetUrl}}

If you didn't request this, no action is needed — your password stays the same.

You received this email because of activity on your {{appName}} account.
If this wasn't you, you can safely ignore this message.
sys_email_template.body_text:
Hi {{user.name}},

We received a request to reset the password for {{user.email}}.

Reset your password (link expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes):
{{resetUrl}}

If you didn't request this, ignore this email.
sys_email_template.description: Sent when a user requests a password reset via better-auth.
sys_email_template.variables_json: [{"name":"user.name","type":"string","required":false,"description":"Recipient display name"},{"name":"user.email","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Recipient email"},{"name":"resetUrl","type":"url","required":true,"description":"Password reset URL"},{"name":"expiresInMinutes","type":"number","required":false,"description":"Link TTL in minutes"},{"name":"appName","type":"string","required":false,"description":"Product/app name (brand override)"}]

sys_email_template.name: auth.verify_email
sys_email_template.label: Verify Email Address
sys_email_template.subject: Verify your {{appName}} email address
sys_email_template.body_html:
Verify your email

Hi {{user.name}},

Thanks for signing up for {{appName}}! Please confirm {{user.email}} belongs to you.

Verify email

Or copy and paste this URL into your browser:
{{verificationUrl}}

You received this email because of activity on your {{appName}} account.
If this wasn't you, you can safely ignore this message.
sys_email_template.description: Sent when better-auth needs to verify a newly-registered email address.

sys_email_template.name: auth.magic_link

sys_email_template.subject: Your {{appName}} sign-in link
sys_email_template.body_html:
Sign in to {{appName}}

Click the button below to sign in. This link expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes and may only be used once.

Sign in

Or paste:
{{magicLinkUrl}}

Accept invitation

{{acceptUrl}}

sys_email_template.name: auth.two_factor_otp
sys_email_template.label: Two-Factor Verification Code
sys_email_template.subject: Your {{appName}} verification code
sys_email_template.body_html:
Your verification code

Use this code to complete sign-in:

{{otp}}

This code expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes. If you didn't try to sign in, change your password — your account may be at risk.

You received this email because of activity on your {{appName}} account.
If this wasn't you, you can safely ignore this message.
sys_email_template.description: Time-based OTP delivered for two-factor / email-OTP login.
